name: Bitbucket MCP
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Bitbucket Cloud and Server API integration (hardened read-only by default)
author: Bitbucket MCP Team

BITBUCKET_TOKEN.description: Bitbucket access token for authentication. Prefer read-only scope.

BITBUCKET_PASSWORD.description: Bitbucket app password/API token (used with username authentication)

BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE.description: Default Bitbucket workspace to use when not specified

BITBUCKET_ENABLE_WRITE.description: Explicit opt-in for write operations. Default false/read-only.

BITBUCKET_ENABLE_DANGEROUS.description: Second opt-in for destructive delete operations; requires write mode.

BITBUCKET_PROXY_DEBUG.description: Enable minimal credential-redacted proxy diagnostics on stderr.

documentation.setup: See SECURITY.md for hardened read-only configuration and explicit write opt-in.
